items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: Fletcher was arranging for Benny, and he was getting me to arrange for him.

ctx.x: So when they say "Swing Man," then Benny Goodman said (unintelligible), and I had them diving and cutting, and Benny was playing. And he made it --
You wrote it all out for him.
